title: A work order opened from its history shows its reps as plain text
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Three active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A}, {Sales-rep-B} and {Sales-rep-C}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able, {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able and {Sales-rep-C} is ZZAUTOTEST Cara Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has {Sales-rep-C} as its one sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its card shows "Sales Representative - Labor" reading {Sales-rep-A} and "Sales Representative - Parts" reading {Sales-rep-B}, and its history holds a version saved after both were set (for example after a line was added).
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1}'s history.
  2. Open the version saved after both representatives were set.
  3. Hover over the representative rows.
  4. Click "Sales Representative - Parts".
  5. Open the work order's menu and look for Print Work Order.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the history opens.
  • Step 2: that version of the work order opens. Without hovering, "Sales Representative - Labor" {Sales-rep-A} and "Sales Representative - Parts" {Sales-rep-B} show as plain text with their labels; the customer's {Sales-rep-C} is not shown. Measured on the screen, every gap between Lead Technician, Service Advisor and both representative fields is 16 px.
  • Step 3: no box, no arrow, no + and no remove x.
  • Step 4: nothing opens and nothing can be changed.
  • Step 5: Print Work Order is not offered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative), story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative)

  • S2-R17: “Once the work order is invoiced or paid, or when it is opened from its history, each field is plain text with the same label and wording, with no + or remove x. A work order with both fields shows both labels with their names. On the read-only card only the Sales Representative fields read as in S1-R2 and S2-R5; Lead Technician and Service Advisor keep today's read-only labels.”
  • S1-N1: “A user without 'Work Orders — Create & Edit', or a work order that is invoiced, paid or opened from its history, shows the field as plain text with the same label and wording, with no + or remove x. If a change is sent by any other route, the system refuses it.”
  • S1-R6: “The vertical gap between Lead Technician, Service Advisor and every Sales Representative field on the card is 16px. This holds with one field, with the Labor and Parts fields (S2-R5), and on the read-only card (S2-R17).”
  • Story 6 prerequisites: “The work order is printed from its menu, with Print Work Order. Print is not offered on a work order opened from its history.”

From: Tech plan "Splitting Sales Representatives — Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 14 Oct 2026, planned against PRD version 8; uploaded 19 Oct 2026 and again, byte-identical, 22 Oct 2026), read in full 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan, history snapshot (section 4.2): “Nothing on the read-only historical card reads the customer's reps (the WO card reads `workOrder.sales_rep_*`).”
  • Tech plan, S1-R6 gap measurement (Phase 5): “measure the vertical gap between Lead Technician → Service Advisor → each Sales Representative field in all of: the editable card, the read-only card (invoiced), the history card, the split card (Labor + Parts)”
